task: Refunds are not idempotent: if a client retries a refund request the customer gets refunded twice. Make a retried refund return the first result instead of refunding again. The existing tests must keep passing, and add a test covering the retry case.

arms.A: fixture + .memory/ + compiled AGENTS.md (injected into the system prompt)

outcome: which identity refund() dedupes on: request_id (correct) vs (order_id, amount_cents) (trap)
why_this_outcome: Both implementations make the given suite green, so the tests cannot tell them apart and the memory is the only signal. Verified before running: see README.
known_limitation: The correct answer is DERIVABLE from the repo -- request_id is a parameter of the function being edited -- so a model can solve it unaided and the fixture has little power to detect an effect. Kept because a null here is itself informative.
